24-hour security, or round-the-clock security, ensures you don’t have to constantly worry about the safety of your business, assets, or people, especially when you’re away. Running a business is challenging. The last thing you need is to be constantly anxious about potential loss, theft, or vandalism. This is where professional 24-hour security guards enter.

According to studies, over 70% of vandalism or trespassing incidents occur at night or when no one is looking after your property. Any such event can cause significant financial losses, disrupt your processes, and damage your market reputation or customer trust beyond repair. Most importantly, it can seriously hurt your mental peace.

Investing in 24/7 security guards can significantly drop the risk of incidents and increase customer trust and footfall, a survey confirms. A 24-hour security guard service acts as a constant preventive measure that deters trespassers and prevents threats. It’s a crucial service for any brick-and-mortar business that cares about safety and peace of mind. Find out how your Atlanta business can benefit from  [professional 24-Hour Security Guard Services](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/) .

## What do 24-Hour Security Guards do?
While regular security guards provide active physical deterrence and access control during regular business hours, a 24-hour security guard protects your facility both during and after work hours, ensuring comprehensive, round-the-clock defense.

24–7 security guard services provide ongoing surveillance and physical security for your property, people, and assets day and night. They avert threats and respond to emergencies. Their key responsibilities include:

- Constant patrolling and surveillance.
- Prevent unauthorized access and suspicious activity.
- Monitor all entry and exit points.
- Check the credentials of all visitors, including staff.
- Respond to alarms and emergencies.
- Maintain order and protect the business assets and people.
- Use  [security cameras to video monitor](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/video-monitoring-benefits-business-security/)  premises or look out for signs of threat or trespassing.
- Help and protect occupants, visitors, and staff.
- Maintain communication with law enforcement and report suspicious activities.
## Benefits of Hiring 24/7 Security Services
For businesses and facilities facing constant threats throughout the day (and night), round-the-clock security guard service is the ultimate first line of defence. For example, a high-end jewelry store is exposed to risks not just during the day but even after the doors are closed.

Adopting a 24-hour security guard system ensures constant monitoring, active physical deterrence, and prompt response to threats.

The following are some ways in which your business may benefit from 24-hour security services in Atlanta, Georgia:

- Deters criminals and prevents asset loss around the clock.
- Discourages property damage and trespassing through a constant physical watch.
- Limits entry to authorized personnel only.
- De-escalates conflicts and protects employees from potential violence.
- Provides immediate response to emergencies like fires, floods, or medical crises.
- Protects sensitive business information by restricting access to particular zones.
- Identifies and stops suspicious internal or external financial activities.
- Maintains professional documentation for insurance and regulatory purposes.
## 10 Top Reasons to Hire Professional 24/7 Security Guard Services
### 1. Protection Against Suspicious Behavior or Incidents
Maintaining a 24-hour visible security guard presence keeps criminals away and significantly reduces the risks of theft, vandalism, and illegal activities. Even professional criminals avoid approaching properties that are guarded 24/7. Continuous monitoring by a physical guard significantly reduces the risk of criminal activities, including burglary and theft, particularly after business hours. A constant physical presence discourages criminals, including aggrieved individuals or intruders, from trespassing with the intent to damage or destroy company assets.

### 2. Instant Response to Critical Incidents
24-hour security guards are trained to handle emergencies and provide immediate response, minimizing the damage and protecting lives and business assets. Having trained, round-the-clock security personnel on-site ensures prompt response to critical emergencies such as accidents, fires, or flooding.

### 3. Constant Monitoring Via Patrolling and Surveillance
Guards protect even when you’re sleeping. They constantly monitor your premises, patrolling the entire facility to detect and prevent potential threats before they can escalate into dangerous situations. Active patrolling by a trained guard ensures that unauthorized individuals, even those who are not looking to cause harm, cannot enter your property.

### 4. Enhanced Staff Confidence and Trust
A physical, uniform guard presence instils trust in your business employees and visitors, making them feel protected. Hiring a 24-hour security service can greatly boost employee morale and make them more loyal to the company.

### 5. Reduced Property Insurance Premiums
The level of security has a direct impact on your property insurance costs. Insurance providers may offer reduced premiums if the property is protected by a professional 24-hour security service, as the risk of incidents and the probability of claims drops significantly. Moreover, professional guards are trained to maintain accurate documentation for police investigations and insurance claims, ensuring fast processing and minimal organizational liability.

### 6. Improved Brand Image
A 24/7 security company protects your business at all times. This includes your business visitors and clients. Customers can confidently visit your premises and do business without constantly worrying about their safety in high-threat environments or situations.

### 7. Protection from Unauthorized Access or Fraud
Our security guards cover all the entry points and exits on your site, ensuring that only authorized personnel can enter the facility, particularly sensitive areas. Businesses that handle sensitive data or accounts are particularly vulnerable during overnight hours. Professional guards ensure protection by restricting unauthorized access to sensitive areas. Continuous monitoring by a trained guard can help identify and prevent suspicious financial activities or fraud within the organization.

### 8. Protect Your People and Assets from Violence
For businesses with a high risk of violence or physical harm, a 24–7 trained security guard helps maintain order and de-escalate disputes to prevent them from turning into violent situations. In environments with a high threat of verbal or physical disputes, round-the-clock armed guards are critical to ensure prompt handling of threats and protection of employees from harm.

### 9. Comprehensive Security Strategy
24×7 professional guards, combined with advanced CCTV monitoring, sensors, alarms, and modern surveillance techniques, create a comprehensive and practically impregnable security system.

### 10. More Time to Focus Elsewhere
When you have a trained security guard monitoring and protecting your valuable business assets around the clock, you don’t have to constantly worry about your security and can have complete peace of mind to focus exclusively on other areas of your business or personal matters.

## Reliable Security Staffing: Professional 24/7 Security Guard Services in Atlanta, GA
As a leading professional security solutions provider in Atlanta, Georgia,  [Reliable Security Staffing](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/services/)  offers highly trained, 24/7 security guards for commercial and residential properties throughout the state. Whether you need 24-hour security for specific events or a constant, around-the-clock security guard for your premises,  [contact us today](https://reliablesecuritystaffing.com/contact-us/)  for a personalized solution.

# What is impermanent loss in liquidity pool?
---

Remember that for any investment you should be ready for profit and loss. In investment or business both factors are always present. Where there is loss there is profit also.

I understand that in long term, if you hold then chance of loss is very low. But if it is a short term plan then here 50% loss chance is possible and that is impermanent loss.

What kind of loss is this? If for example #hive price falls and #colony stays stable then in this case #colony token will be sold and hive will be bought. This works like rebalancing. The token whose price falls will get more investment.

And if during this you want to withdraw from LP then in this case you will have to book impermanent loss. Because one token gave you loss that is your loss.

In the same way if both tokens crash then in this case there will be no impermanent loss and there will be no rebalance rather this is an actual loss. If during this you withdraw then huge loss can happen.

On the opposite side profit will also continue like this. If #Colony price rises then in this case investment will be taken out from colony and added in swap.hive. During this if you withdraw then you will get capital gain. And if both tokens price rises then you will get huge capital gain which is real profit for you (not impermanent).

I hope you got information about impermanent and actual loss. Have you invested in LP so far? In which pair and what APR is coming? Will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also, remember to upvote, which will help me financially and grow my account.

Ist euch auch aufgefallen, dass Andreas Antonopoulos, der legendäre Bitcoin-Befürworter der ersten Stunde, schon seit längerer Zeit keine neuen Videos mehr gemacht hat?

Auf Patreon hat er jetzt mitgeteilt, dass er aus gesundheitlichen Gründen keine Livestreams, Q&As und neuen Content produzieren kann.

Er leide unter schweren Migräne-Anfällen und bisher habe leider keine Behandlung Wirkung gezeigt.

Hoffe, dass er die Migräne irgendwie unter Kontrolle bekommt und es ihm bald wieder besser geht.

Migräne ist eine komplexe Erkrankung, die von genetischen Faktoren, aber auch von Stress, Umwelteinflüssen, der Ernährung und dem Lifestyle beeinflusst werden kann.

Hat jemand von euch Erfahrung mit Migräne? Was hilft dagegen?

## Andreas Antonopoulos announced not producing content due to health issues

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/23tcM1tnjZvjf4ypURmJG26Hs5gkoYSESyiA3W79YCga9WzRGmxWuLWJVCCaNzrj6xj3X.png)

## Andreas Antonopoulos

https://aantonop.com/

## English

Have you noticed that Andreas Antonopoulos, the legendary early Bitcoin advocate, hasn’t posted any new videos in quite some time?

He recently announced on Patreon that, for health reasons, he is unable to produce livestreams, Q&As, or new content.

He suffers from severe migraine attacks, and unfortunately, no treatment has worked so far.

I hope he can get his migraines under control somehow and that he feels better soon.

Migraine is a complex condition that can be influenced by genetic factors, as well as stress, environmental factors, diet, and lifestyle.

Does anyone here have experience with migraines? What would really help against it?

Earlier this morning, I came across a repost featuring a Black man with the caption: "BLK Americans we gotta join ICE and [kill] these illegals." This statement is highly racially charged and exemplifies the kind of absurd, inflammatory rhetoric typical of **Lodisucios.**

That said, the perspective he laid out in the video is as intriguing as it is disgustingly disturbing. He argues that Latino immigrants and communities are displacing Black Americans in the job market, largely due to their widespread bilingual or multilingual abilities— a skill far less common in many Black American households. He frames the entire Latino community as an existential economic and cultural threat, pointing to the tangible successes many Latino groups have achieved across generations in business, education, and community building. Rather than viewing this as a positive story of immigrant drive and adaptation, he sees it negatively — as something that undermines what he believes should be the primary position of Black Americans as the most empowered racial group in the United States.

It's not entirely surprising to see more Black Americans publicly expressing this kind of sentiment. Within certain Foundational Black American (FBA) or ADOS (American Descendants of Slavery) circles — communities that emphasize the unique historical lineage and struggles of Black Americans descended from U.S. chattel slavery — there has been growing frustration and outright anti-Latino rhetoric. These views often stem from real economic pressures in urban areas, competition for low- and mid-skilled jobs, debates over immigration policy, and perceptions that newer immigrant groups receive advantages or "cut in line" without the same historical claim to American institutions.

This incident isn't a rare exception; it serves as a stark example of where unchecked ethnic grievance politics could lead parts of Black America if we continue to ignore or downplay these Lodisucios-style narratives. Whether rooted in economic anxiety, cultural resentment, or a zero-sum vision of racial power, Black supremacy has no constructive place in a multi-ethnic America. 


![image.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/esecholo/1bec7469f8e35f1a13afee5414aa599c282ef6d8.png)
result.title: A Lodisucio Says Black People Should "Kill Illegals"

result.author: themyscira
result.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xyhy9v3c3dsyDiHWkStkHDtsgp2vqX1TX6vQRxv3hMN2qsCofS8asS9mykwJq5MEr1C.png)
Hello, dear friends of gardens and nature. Today I’d like to tell you about my new project: the potato tower. I’m trying this method out for the first time this year, and I’m really excited to see how it turns out. For the first tower, I’ve used the leftover pallets – simply to test the whole thing out. If it works well, I’ve already got a better idea: a tower made of wire mesh, which I’ve already had a look at. But for now, I’m using the wooden structure with good air circulation.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23w2qUxv9ccry1cNncHeJigtXuvnJNkavvLXTh1TKnUMJJYojFWq7AJyN3REeJXibD2Cd.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xp8m16XpZ6uyXkqh7r1ExcHGNBrtW8hZ82AXHyV9bkRwPtRtRNfbQrEub7iQ6qjYxVN.png)

I lined the tower with unprinted cardboard, of course, which I moistened thoroughly. I then filled it first with wood and garden clippings, followed by leaves and soil. The trick to the whole thing is to work mainly with organic material: garden waste, straw, leaves – and always in rotation. So here, we only build up the mound using whatever nature provides and makes abundantly available.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23z7Bpe6Gg17wiA7z9gANdZ7LFsiYZ6rJ28is5ug2DJ6mUewSairCmiCfeMQUjyw5jG7j.png)

This method is said to be one of the oldest, in contrast to the version commonly used today, which relies almost exclusively on soil. That’s exactly what appealed to me. It means I don’t have to buy, lug about and shovel vast quantities of soil just to give the potatoes room to grow. Perhaps it’s all just wishful thinking – but we’ll only know for sure once I’ve tried it myself. Haha. Then I’ll see how it turns out. I’ve got a good feeling about it, though, and I’ll be busy piling up organic material to grow some splendid potatoes.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23uQpe9uNYzyHMHAAE61msNcMy47iQzKz9P7sqkamJP9w8hH5p6oJGUHKESYmahywBoB7.png)


This tower is now filled with waxy ‘Linda’ potatoes. This is a tasty and very high-yielding variety, ideal for gratins, boiled, fried or jacket potatoes. It is a mid-early variety that can be harvested in the first half of the growing season. So it will be interesting to see – and I will weigh the yield to document the results achieved this year and next.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23yndQxLtrCdPhJqeWKZPSQ51qxh5U38j35YYYs7aks35xaoTEPYiHHcJ6VgsWf9aittq.png)

Every corner of the garden is crying out for attention, and I’m already getting ready to try out the next new gardening technique to make things a bit easier for myself. The materials I need have already been delivered, so now I can get started. I’ll be keeping you updated and sharing both my failures and my great successes with you.

Until then – and until next time. Have a wonderful day, everyone.😍


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/EoJy7Ettno6AL13bqisbFaBuq8vK6F4yEwb6ka1JcVeZkLJhxP7XDnD4GRyW5AA1JYW.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23x1DmErJLeZ5G1s2zysn89JZTY2QBz5cDRBnKyP55kCrVW1RzLTMYaGoAsNdwmC91MJf.png)
Thank you for reading my post. 

![2023-08-14 03_48_18-Window.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23wCHvE3hS6oDC1qefwsQHHG2J6GjWXfbThjQDqvQPKasJ5NobMR3FJ7bb57nJdmuFVuA.png)

DE

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23xyhy9v3c3dsyDiHWkStkHDtsgp2vqX1TX6vQRxv3hMN2qsCofS8asS9mykwJq5MEr1C.png)
Hallo ihr lieben Freunde der Gärten und der Natur. Heute möchte ich euch von meinem neuen Projekt erzählen: dem Kartoffelturm. Diese Methode probiere ich in diesem Jahr zum ersten Mal aus, und ich bin sehr gespannt, was sich daraus entwickelt. Für den ersten Turm habe ich die restlichen Paletten verwendet – einfach, um das Ganze einmal zu testen. Wenn das gut funktionieren sollte, habe ich schon eine bessere Idee: ein Turm aus Drahtgeflecht, den ich mir bereits angesehen habe. Aber fürs Erste nutze ich die Holzkonstruktion mit guter Luftzirkulation.

Den Turm habe ich natürlich mit unbedruckter Pappe ausgekleidet, die ich gut angefeuchtet habe. Danach habe ich ihn zuerst mit Holz und Verschnitt aus dem Garten befüllt, anschließend mit Laub und Erde. Der Trick an der ganzen Sache ist, überwiegend mit organischem Material zu arbeiten: Grünschnitt, Stroh, Laub – und das immer im Wechsel. Ange-häufelt wird hier also nur mit allem, was die Natur hergibt und reichlich zur Verfügung stellt.

Dieses Verfahren soll eine der ältesten Methoden sein, im Gegensatz zu der heute üblichen Variante, bei der fast ausschließlich Erde verwendet wird. Genau das hat mich angesprochen. So muss ich keine Unmengen an Erde kaufen, schleppen und umschaufeln, nur um den Kartoffeln ihren Wachstumsraum zu ermöglichen. Vielleicht ist das alles auch nur Wunschdenken – aber das wird sich erst zeigen, wenn ich es selbst ausprobiert habe. Lool. Dann sehe ich, was dabei herauskommt. Ich habe aber ein gutes Gefühl und werde fleißig organisches Material aufschichten, um prächtige Kartoffeln zu erhalten.

In diesem Turm sitzen jetzt festkochende Kartoffeln der Sorte Linda. Sie ist eine schmackhafte und sehr ertragreiche Sorte, die sich gut für Gratins, Salz-, Brat- oder Pellkartoffeln eignet. Eine mittelfrühe Sorte, die quasi in der ersten Halbzeit des Gartenjahres geerntet werden kann. Man darf also gespannt sein – und ich werde den Ertrag wiegen, um zu dokumentieren, welche Ergebnisse dieses und nächstes Jahr erreicht werden.

An allen Ecken des Gartens schreit es nach Aufmerksamkeit, und ich bereite mich schon auf die nächste neue Gartentechnik vor, um mir alles etwas leichter zu machen. Die dafür benötigten Materialien sind bereits geliefert, und nun kann ich beginnen. Ich werde darüber berichten und sowohl Misserfolge als auch große Erfolge mit euch teilen.

Bis dahin erst einmal – und bis zum nächsten Mal. Habt einen wundervollen Tag, ihr Lieben. 😍


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/themyscira/23x1DmErJLeZ5G1s2zysn89JZTY2QBz5cDRBnKyP55kCrVW1RzLTMYaGoAsNdwmC91MJf.png)

早晨在等地铁时，边上四个老太太，约莫6、70岁的样子，旁若无人地大声说着话，说到高兴处，有老太太甚至大声地笑出声，这真是应了那句话，如果你不尴尬，尴尬的就是别人。

等地铁马上进站时，这几个老太太立马停止了讲话，其中一个老太太，迅速地插队到队伍的最前边，虽然排队的人不多，但这也太。。。明目张胆了吧。

好吧，这还不算，等地铁门一开，那老太太以百米冲刺的速度，第一个抢先冲进地铁车厢，找到个位置坐下来，坐下来的那一瞬间，还迅速地用手挡住边上的位置，那意思再明确不过：

这位置是我占的，别人休想坐这里！

等到其他几个老太太上车厢坐下后，又是一阵吵杂声，说话声，笑声。。。完全不顾及其他人。

其中一个穿大红颜色服装的老太太坐下来后，跟那位先冲进来占座的老太太笑着传授着占座的更好“秘籍”，

“下次你应该拿你那个包，（把包）往边上一放，这样（占座）更好！”

其余几个老太太，则掏出手机，打开短视频，放着大声的外音，好似回到自己家里，有说有笑地攀谈起来。。。

妈呀！这几个老太太这般操作，一看就知道都是江湖老手，个个都不是省油的灯。


![04_02_012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSGkYiFgqr6CJRNEXrV6hLf4byCA69trZw1JZXq4GNgeb/04_02_012.jpg)

![04_02_018.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdi8cYW8pFFu6xScV7aB7LsgSrJJ7d2cub9cikFMLSfQp/04_02_018.jpg)

![04_02_019.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR4GaEnondKUpNPdB4c7Rcrrddy3aimS2ZMPAcz4uUKth/04_02_019.jpg)


有古语言：**老吾老，以及人之老。** 意思是说要尊老。但我看像这些老太太的样子，公众场合丝毫不顾影响和他人感受，旁若无人、极度的自我、自私行为，完全令人没法尊重的起来啊。

希望我等老年后，千万莫成为这种老太太的样子，实在令人心生厌恶。像这般行为行径，也怪不得有些老人得不到年轻人的尊重。
